caption:
Sylvester Stallone is officially leaning into the AI wave, admitting on a podcast that he faced heavy backlash from Hollywood for trying to pitch a half-human, half-AI movie. While he agrees with the creative community's complaints, he argued that the tech is an unstoppable avalanche and even advised his daughter to look into gaming instead. As AI avatars and digital likenesses reshape entertainment, how long before legacy stars become their own digital franchises? Let me know your thoughts below! 🎬🤖✨

Source: Variety
